title: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails on this host at base
body: internal/runstate's maintenance fixture test fails on this machine ('a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing'), reproduced identically on the unchanged tree, so it predates 3h0 and is environment- or git-version dependent (git's fetch-triggered maintenance not firing when armed). It is the only red in the full suite outside internal/reconcile, and it makes `make test` ungreen for reasons this epic did not cause. Same finding as attempt 2's report — deduplicates.
